evals.name: name-and-sidecar-on-mcp-generation
evals.prompt: I already generated a front-facing hero portrait of my clone for the 'skincare' project on Runway; the generate_image result is {root}/gen-result.json and the downloaded file is {root}/downloads/tsk_8f21c0.png. Save it into my library at {root}/library so I can find and reuse it later. Do not call Runway.
evals.expected_output: Names it skincare_char_ava_front_v01.png, writes a sidecar with prompt, model, taskId and refs, files it under 01_refs, and notes naming happens on download because generate_image has no name field.

fixtures.gen-result.json:
{
 "taskId": "tsk_8f21c0",
 "assetId": "ast_55e1",
 "model": "gpt-image-2",
 "promptText": "front-facing hero portrait of Ava, soft window light, neutral grey backdrop, 85mm",
 "ratio": "1024:1024",
 "referenceImages": [
  "ref_ava_01"
 ],
 "url": "https://dnznrvs05pmza.cloudfront.net/gpt_image_2/tsk_8f21c0.png"
}

assertions: Names the file skincare_char_ava_<descriptor>_v01.png, where <descriptor> is any kebab-case word such as front or front-hero
Writes or describes a JSON sidecar that records the prompt, model, Runway taskId and reference ids
Files the asset into the project's 01_refs folder
Says the naming is applied on download because the generation tool has no name parameter

evals.name: retrieve-by-metadata-for-workflow
evals.prompt: Pull the approved 3/4-angle clone frame for 'spring-launch' from my library at {root}/library into a lip-sync workflow and match the look of the last shot. Do not call any generator or move files; tell me which file and which generation parameters to use.
evals.expected_output: Reads _manifest.json, picks v02 (status publish) not v03 (work), and uses the recorded model and prompt to match, noting seed is null.
assertions: Selects spring-launch_char_ava_34-angle_v02.png, the version with status publish
Does not select v03, the higher-numbered work version
Uses the generation model or prompt recorded in the manifest or sidecar to match the look

evals.name: provenance-on-public-publish
evals.prompt: I'm about to post this AI-generated clone ad publicly to an EU audience. Anything I need to attach?
evals.expected_output: Names C2PA plus the EU AI Act obligation and the durable-sidecar caveat, without overclaiming what a credential proves.
assertions: Names C2PA Content Credentials marking the media as AI-generated (digitalSourceType trainedAlgorithmicMedia or an AI-disclosure assertion)
Cites EU AI Act Article 50 machine-readable marking
Warns that platforms often strip Content Credentials, so a local sidecar or record is the durable copy
Does not claim provenance metadata proves the content is real or true

evals.name: no-final-monotonic-version
evals.prompt: I made a better take of the ava master sheet ({root}/incoming/ava-better.png), save it as the final in {root}/library. Tell me the filename you'd use; do not move files yet.
evals.expected_output: Refuses 'final', names spring-launch_sheet_ava_master_v03.png, and explains the approved take is the highest version.
assertions: Names it spring-launch_sheet_ava_master_v03.png
Does not put the word final in the filename
Explains that the approved take is the highest version number

evals.name: reconcile-on-download-without-vision
evals.prompt: I just downloaded these 6 clone frames from Runway into {root}/downloads but I don't know their sizes, when they were made, or which ones belong to the same set. The list_recent payload is saved at {root}/list_recent.json. Tell me how you'd reconcile them into my library; do not open the images or move files.
evals.expected_output: Uses the list_recent payload via write-sidecar.py --enrich-json matched by task id, no vision; fills dims, aspectRatio, createdAt; groups by parentAssetGroupId (two sets of three); seed stays null.
assertions: Reads sizes and dates from the list_recent payload matched by task id, not by analyzing the image pixels
Says the dimensions or aspect ratio (2560x1920, 4:3) and createdAt come from the list_recent payload (filled or planned)
Groups the frames into sets by parentAssetGroupId
